entries.name: fox
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single finished square default user avatar for a social companion app, ultimately shown at 40–80 pixels in a circle. Style: premium soft matte 3D clay and very subtle short velvety plush illustration, rounded clean forms, friendly but not infantile, simple large glossy dark eyes, tiny gentle smile, softly lit. Front-facing centered head and tiny upper shoulders, head about 65% of canvas width, entire ears and facial features safely inside a central circular crop with even generous margins. Solid pale pastel backdrop edge-to-edge, fully opaque, square. Exactly one animal; no text, letters, logos, accessories, scenery, borders, frames, watermark, collage, or mockup. Match a cohesive collection of cream cat on mint and warm brown teddy bear on peach. Subject: A friendly round red-orange fox with soft cream cheeks and muzzle, small triangular ears, pale powder-blue backdrop.
